name: default-ai-security
description: Standard baseline security policy for AI applications

rules.name: Block Prompt Injection
rules.description: Block adversarial prompt injection and jailbreak attempts

rules.name: Block Secrets
rules.description: Prevent credential and API key exposure

rules.name: Redact PII
rules.description: Sanitize personally identifiable information in requests

rules.description: Block any request with a composite risk score >= 0.85
